9.title: Write free text anywhere on the board

thinking_budget.evidence: no thinking-budget flag on gufo's command line (the launcher has none to set)

kv_cache_type.evidence: gufo's CLI has no KV-cache type switch (lib/gufo.sh), and the type it uses internally isn't on the command line

client.evidence: pi runs without --thinking and sends no reasoning effort (clients.py)
